summary: Frontend-only testing of Phase 3 redesign for Relatorios, Analise (Dashboard/Clientes) and WhatsApp pages (Config/AntiSpam/Templates/Logs). Logged in as pro@kredorteste.com (Turnstile test key auto-passes). All 8 target pages loaded successfully with new visual pattern (PageHeader with lucide icons + font-cabinet titles, SectionCard with ring-1 ring-border, StatusBadge). No pictographic emojis found in UI body text on any tested page. No JavaScript console errors except 2 expected 403 responses on /whatsapp when Evolution API is not configured (banner behavior). PDF/Excel format toggle on Relatorios switches active state correctly (different ring classes applied).

integration_issues.issue: Two API calls return 403 when Evolution API is not configured. Non-blocking (banner de aviso is shown) but should ideally be caught silently to avoid console noise.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Silence or catch the two 403 responses on /whatsapp when Evolution API is not configured so console is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Rotas /analise and /analise/dashboard both mount AnaliseDashboard with the same header 'Análise de Clientes' — considered whether /analise root should redirect to /analise/dashboard to avoid duplicate mount, but current behavior is functional.

WhatsAppTemplates textareas contain emojis in the *default template content* (👋 📣 🗓 💰). These are user-facing message payloads, not UI decoration, so they do not violate the 'no UI emojis' rule; flagging for awareness only.
Templates default seed text includes emojis — if the product goal is 'zero emojis end-to-end', main agent should scrub default template seeds as well.
seed_data_creation: None. DB empty as expected; empty-state UIs rendered correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via /login with email 'pro@kredorteste.com' and password 'Kredor@2026'. Turnstile uses test keys and passes automatically after ~2-3s wait. Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (https://cred-preview-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Routes verified in App.js: /relatorios, /analise, /analise/dashboard, /analise/clientes, /whatsapp, /whatsapp/anti-spam, /whatsapp/templates, /whatsapp/logs. No emojis found on Phase 3 redesigned pages. Only console noise: 2x 403 on /whatsapp (Evolution API not configured — expected).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in scope.
